answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 19023 Country: India Title: Doctor taking commissions from Diagnostic Centres OR Medical Halls Question: Assalaamalaikum, Im a Doctor by profession.I get alot of commission offers from Diagnostics Centres & Medical Hall. Is it permitted to take commissions from Diagnostic Centres OR Medical Halls (for the investigations I'm advicing or medications I'm prescribing). Answer ID: 19023 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 152/151/B=1431) It is not lawful for you to receive the commission of medical hall and diagnostic centre only in return of advice and prescription. Yes, if you undertake some efforts or struggle in the same, you can receive it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
